headline: Congress renamed the Shoshoni, Wyoming post office after Dessie A. Bebout.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service building at 112 Wyoming Street in Shoshoni, Wyoming, the Dessie A. Bebout Post Office. It only changes the name of the building. It does not change how mail is delivered or what services the office offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 25, 2024.
